title: Veil and Hollow
author: Kestrel Winterbourne
blurb: Noor Zhou, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
